name: lich's mastery
mana cost: {3}{B}{B}{B}
types: legendary enchantment
static: hexproof
triggered: whenever you gain life, draw that many cards.
triggered: whenever you lose life, for each 1 life you lost, exile a permanent you control or a card from your hand or graveyard.
triggered: when CARDNAME leaves the battlefield, you lose the game.
replacement: you can't lose the game.
